items.title: IGI reports 85.7% Q3 combined ratio as reserve releases mask tougher underlying trends
items.summary: International General Insurance Holdings posted an 85.7% combined ratio for the third quarter of 2026, though underlying figures reveal higher accident-year losses and a greater reliance on prior-year reserve releases.

items.title: Insurance Business sets entry deadline for Top Insurance Employers 2027
items.summary: Insurance Business UK has announced that organisations have until November 13 to submit entries for its Top Insurance Employers 2027 awards.

items.title: TPT applies for multi-employer CDC scheme authorisation
items.summary: TPT Retirement Solutions has submitted an application to The Pensions Regulator to launch a multi-employer collective defined contribution scheme.

items.title: Hiscox London Market premiums rise 9.9% despite rate softening
items.summary: Hiscox London Market grew its written premiums to $1.05bn in the first nine months of the year while rates fell by 5%.

items.title: Lancashire declares US$182M special dividend amid property retrocession pullback
items.summary: Lancashire Holdings has declared a special dividend of 75 cents per common share, totalling approximately US$182 million, as it scales back its property retrocession book in a softening specialty market.

items.title: Browne Jacobson warns on cyber insurance gaps and AI liability risks
items.summary: Legal experts highlight that treating cyber policies as a simple tick-box exercise and integrating custom AI tools are driving fresh insurance disputes.
